title: Eve Meeting Note Pull Reconciler Authority

responsibilities.unknown_policy: The reconciler is a pull-only loop closer: it may read Eve session streams through the authenticated EveSessionClient and write meeting notes exclusively through meetingAutomationService.recordNoteGeneration, while candidate tool calls use meetingAutomationService.recordCandidates. The persisted run scope and source_text_hash remain the write-back validators of record, and malformed candidate lists are rejected before any output mutation. An already-generated note is never rewritten; when the same session is still active and candidate outputs remain awaiting-Eve, polling may continue only until candidates arrive or the session terminates. Sessions that end without a matching note are surfaced as blocked dispatch runs (operator_review_eve_session), candidate write failures after session end require operator_review_eve_candidates, transient stream failures retain running state for retry, and the human publish, task creation, and external-send approvals stay in Brainbase untouched by this worker.
